reddit.title: Introducing Improved Unit Movement in Provincia
reddit.body: We’ve made significant changes to how units move and engage in battles in Provincia. No more confusing teleports or awkward formations! Check out the details on our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march

posts: Exciting updates on unit movement mechanics in Provincia! Discover how we’re enhancing the battle experience with more realistic formations and engagements.
